label: Langley Composite Squadron
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3 in (group, squadron and activity patches 3 in); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions

ground_removed.colour: none: the ground was already clear (alpha 3 or less, white or black colour under it)
ground_removed.flood: 4-neighbour flood from the picture's edge over pixels with alpha 3 or less

band.rule: alpha from the pixel colour's place between white and the outline's solid colour, colour taken from the outline

stray_marks_removed.rule: detached marks outside the outline, none touching the emblem

provenance: Unit emblem of Langley Composite Squadron (MAR-VA-025), digital artwork sent by the owner, 2026-11-18, as the unit's official digital emblem. Official digital artwork shipped as given: png (8-bit RGBA), 261 x 287 px, 8-bit RGBA; the file came with its ground already clear but with a pale fringe: the edge pixels were blended with white (alpha rose over a few pixels while the colour was pale). The 1456 px of that edge were given their alpha from where their colour lies between white and the outline's own solid colour (#08266f) and took that colour (348 of them are clear), and 16 px in 5 detached stray marks outside the outline were cleared; the picture was trimmed to the emblem's box (261 x 287 px to 226 x 270 px); every pixel inside the emblem's outline is untouched; no resampling, no redrawing, no tracing, no other colour change. The picture is small (226 x 270 px after trimming) and ships at its own pixel size, not enlarged; a larger picture from the unit would print and show sharper. Charter: MAR-VA-025 is printed on the emblem (VA-025) and is listed as MAR-VA-025 Langley Composite Squadron on the Virginia Wing's own news page of Quality Cadet Unit awards.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only changes are the pale edge made a clean outline, the stray marks outside it removed, and the trim to the emblem's box.
